kernel_of_truth: The SAA western-cell drift is real, well-measured physics, and the CHAOS model family is the canonical source for tracking it — Finlay et al. 2020 (the SAA secular-variation paper our own detail_reasoning cites) is literally the CHAOS-7 model paper. The dome picked a genuinely respectable source. What it got wrong is the product's existence and cadence: there is no 'monthly SAA map available early June', and the model version it named was already deprecated at registration.

data_source_finding.summary: The dome's stated verification source for PRED-073 ('CHAOS-7 / NOAA NGDC monthly geomagnetic field maps, typically available early June') is structurally unable to produce an April->May 2026 SAA-centroid measurement. Verified by direct fetch of both DTU Space model pages on 2026-06-06.
data_source_finding.chaos7_status: DEPRECATED. DTU page header: 'PLEASE NOTE: CHAOS-7 is now out-dated.' Final release CHAOS-7.18 uses Swarm L1b data only up to 2 June 2024 and ground observatory data to end of April 2024. A CHAOS-7 May-2026 datapoint will NEVER exist.
data_source_finding.chaos8_status: CHAOS-8 (successor, Kloss et al. 2026, EPS, doi:10.1186/s40623-025-02352-0) is 'valid from 1999 to 2025'; site last updated 03-Mar-2026. No published CHAOS release covers April-May 2026 as of today.
data_source_finding.cadence_reality: CHAOS releases land roughly 1-2x/year with multi-month observation-to-release latency (7.18: data to Jun 2024; 8.x: validity to 2025, released Mar 2026). A monthly SAA-centroid product 'available early June' for May data does not exist in this family. NOAA NGDC (now NCEI) surface field maps are model-derived on multi-year epochs, not monthly observational maps.
data_source_finding.earliest_possible_resolution: A measured April->May 2026 SAA-centroid drift cannot appear before a future CHAOS-8 update extending validity into mid-2026 — realistically late 2026 at the earliest, possibly 2027. Alternative routes (raw Swarm L1b, ground observatories) require custom modeling work the dome has never demonstrated.

implications: 1. VERDICT BASIS UNCHANGED BUT REFRAMED: our falsified verdict rests on the stable secular-rate null hypothesis (~0.024 deg/mo vs dome >=0.3 deg/mo, 12x). This is now not merely 'defensible pending data' — it is the ONLY achievable basis on the dome's own stated source. No measured May-2026 value is coming on any near timeline.

Data-source unavailability mitigates the 'no result posted' element of silent-ignore, but NOT the acknowledgment element — the dome has posted nothing: no window-closure note, no data-delay note, no extension. Silence remains silent-ignore; the escalation rationale should cite the acknowledgment gap, not the missing datapoint.

4. VERIFICATION-DESIGN DEFECT (new structural point): PRED-073 was registered 2026-04-04 citing a model that was already deprecated (CHAOS-8 had superseded CHAOS-7; CHAOS-7 data ends mid-2024) and a monthly product cadence that does not exist. The prediction was unverifiable-as-registered on its own stated source. This rhymes with the OTS canary pattern: crypto-theater on the answer sheet, verification-theater on the data source — the apparatus of falsifiability without the operational substance.
